title: Exterior entrances labelled Tam Wing Fan Innovation Wing and Tam Wing Fan Innovation Wing II
objects_and_counts: At least 8 human silhouettes are visible in the left panel, positioned along the front entrance and walkways; several silhouettes are partially cropped or semi-opaque (appear as render silhouettes).

Two distinct labelled entrance canopies/covered walkways are visible: one in the left panel over the main glass frontage and one in the right panel over a recessed undercroft; both are continuous architectural elements rather than freestanding signs.

Multiple full-height glazed storefronts/entrance doors and glass panels are visible along the ground floor in both panels; individual panes are distinguishable but an exact pane count cannot reliably be determined from the image.
One freestanding low planter with shrubs is visible in the foreground right of the left panel (near the paved plaza); additional planting beds are visible but not individually countable.
Several interior chairs are visible through the glass in the right panel: at least two green chairs are visible near the rightmost glass panel.

A building façade with many rectangular windows occupies the upper stories behind the ground-floor entrances in the left panel; exact window counts per floor are not provided because of partial cropping and perspective.
visible_text: Tam Wing Fan Innovation Wing II
spatial_relations: The primary entrance canopy runs horizontally across the lower portion of both panels, with glass-fronted rooms beneath it and the taller brick-faced building rising directly behind the canopy.
In the left panel the paved plaza occupies the foreground; the glass entrances and storefronts sit directly behind that plaza and a small planted area is to the right of the plaza.
In the right panel a recessed undercroft or covered walkway extends under the building mass, with glass-fronted rooms set into the right side of the recess and an open paved area in the foreground.
Interior chairs visible through glass in the right panel are positioned just inside the rightmost glass wall, directly adjacent to the covered walkway.
The taller brick building with repeated rectangular windows is immediately behind the ground-floor innovation wing; the canopy appears to connect to the brick building at multiple vertical supports.

Ground-floor frontage and canopy areas are predominantly white or light-coloured, with large glass panels and glazed doors.
The ground/plaza surface is a terracotta or orange-brown paved material (brick or pavers appearance).
Interior chairs visible through glass are green; planted areas contain green foliage.
